sources.author: Pichuliru
sources.changes: Converted all 20 source OBJ meshes with their MTL palette material and shared T_PCL_Palette_c.png in Blender to self-contained GLBs; applied transforms, baked flat shading, kept the 1-unit-equals-1-metre scale, and oriented each long axis from the grip toward the striking end along +x. The OBJ MTL's palette path was resolved to the shared texture at the archive root.
sources.title: CC0 Flat Shaded Melee Weapons

sources.author: neincenets
sources.changes: Converted pipe.obj in Blender to a self-contained GLB; the download references a missing pipe.mtl, so applied a neutral metallic steel material. Used a non-uniform source-unit scale of 0.18 m/unit along the 5.15-unit shaft and 0.05 m/unit across both transverse axes (0.278 relative scale), yielding a 0.927 m shaft, 3.3 cm tube diameter and 11.7 cm elbow extent. The grip is at the lower end and the strike anchor at the upper open end; oriented the long shaft along +x.
sources.title: Pipe
